items.title: Degree-four Amitsur groups as stable birational invariants of finite group actions on rational varieties
items.author: Andrew Kresch; Yuri Tschinkel
items.difficulty_reason: The higher Amitsur invariant requires equivariant stack/group cohomology, etale motivic complexes and their blow-up decompositions, equivariant weak factorization and a degree-four connecting-map construction, then proves stable invariance and several vanishing/functoriality properties. Complete author smooth-projective rationality, finite-group and Picard hypotheses retained; this is an independent cohomological invariant theorem beyond the old divisorial-model proposition.

primary.label: complete original degree-four Amitsur stable-birational theorem with all four properties

proof_spans.label: complete original equivariant weak-factorization, motivic blow-up, stable, fixed-point and functoriality proof

contexts.label: complete original equivariant, stack/cohomological and motivic Amitsur setup with blow-up theorem and degree-four definition
original examples, divisorial models, Burnside comparison and geometric applications retained as uncounted context
